paite: Huan gentehna thu in akiang uah agen a, "Mi kuahiam in grephuan abawl a, akim huang in a-um a, grep sukna ding khuk atou a, insang alam a, loukhou mite kiang ah khohloh ding in apia a, gamdang ah apaisanta hi.
heading: Grephuan Gentehna Thu / (Mat 21.33-46; Luk 20.9-19)
english: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

paite: Agah loh hun in atansik amau kiang a kipan la ding in lou khohloh mite kiang ah sikha khat asawl hi.
english: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

paite: Huai mi ana man ua, avua ua, khutvuak in apaisak uhi.
english: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

paite: Huan sikha dang akiang uah asawl nawn a; huai mi leng alu ana hihliam ua, zumhuaipi in ana bawl uhi.
english: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

paite: Huan sikha dang asawl nawn zel a; huai mi ana that ua, sikha dang tampi leng, khenkhat ana vua ua, khenkhat ana that uhi.
english: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.

paite: Huan sawl ding khat, atapa deihtak kia anei lai hi; 'Ka tapa zaw ana zahtak ding uh' chi in amah ananungpen in akiang uah asawl hi.
english: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

paite: Himahleh huai lou khohloh mite'n, 'hiai mi gouluah dingpa ahi; i that ding uh aw; huchi in agouluah ding ei a ahi mai ding,' akichi uhi.
english: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

paite: Huchi in amah aman ua, that in, grephuan a pan alawnkhia uhi.
english: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

paite: Huaiziak in grephuan neipa'n bangchi in ahon hih dia? Lou khohloh mite ahon hihmangthang dia; grephuan midangte ape ding hi.
english: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

paite: Hiai Laisiangthou na sim kei ua hia? 'Inn lam mite' suang deih louhpen, huai mahmah aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita hi.
english: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.

paite: Huai Toupa hih ahi, i mitmuh un alamdang hi, chih,' " achi hi.
english: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”

paite: Huan amah mat atum ua; himahleh huai gentehna thu amau dem a agen ahi chih atheih ziak un, mipite alau uhi. Huchi in amah anusia ua, apaimangta uhi.
english: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.

paite: Huan athugen a mat ahihtheihna ding in Pharisaite leh Herod pawl a mi kuate hiam akiang ah asawl uhi.
heading: Leiman Thu A Dotna / (Mat 22.15-22; Luk 20.20-26)
english: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

paite: Huchi in amau ahong tun un akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, midiktat na hi a, deihsak tuam kuamah na nei kei chih ka thei uh, kuamah khentuam nei lou in, chihtak ngial in Pathian lam thu na hilh zel hi; Kaisar kiang a leiman liau asiang hia siang lou?
english: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

paite: Pe ding ka hi uhia, pe lou ding?" achi uhi. Ama'n alepchiahdan uh thei in, akiang uah, "Bangziak a hon ze-et na hi ua? Makhai hon tawi un, ka en ding," achi hi.
english: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”

paite: Ahon tawi ua, ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai kua lim leh kua min ahia?" achi hi.
english: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”

paite: Amau, "Kaisar a," achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Kaisar thilte Kaisar kiang ah pia unla, Pathian thilte Pathian kiang ah peta unla," achi hi. Huchi in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.

paite: Huan Saddukai, thohnawnna a-om kei chite, akiang ah ahong ua,
heading: Thohnawnna Thu A Dotna / (Mat 22.23-33; Luk 20.27-40)
english: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,

paite: akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, Mosi in, kuapeuh a-unaupa'n ta nei lou in azi sihsan taleh a-unaupa'n azi luah in a-unaupa a ding in chi asuahsak ding chi in ahon gelhsak hi.
english: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

paite: Ahi, sal sagih a-om ua; a-upapen in zi anei a, chi suah lou in asi hi.
english: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

paite: Huan anihna in aluah a, chi suah lou in asi nawn zel a; athumna in huchi mah bang in.
english: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

paite: Huchi in sal sagihte chi suah lou in asita ua, atawpna ah numei leng asita hi.
english: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

paite: Thohnawn hun in akua pen zi ahi dia le? Sagihte'n zi in anei chiat ngal ua," chi in adong uhi.
english: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Hiai ziak hilou hia, na theihkhelh nak uh, Laisiangthou leh Pathian thilhihtheihna na theih louh ziak un?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?

paite: Misi lak a pan athohnawn hun un zi leh pasal a kinei lou in, van angelte bang ahi zawta ding uh ahi.
english: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

paite: Huan misite kaihthoh a a-om ding thu lah Mosi laibu a loubukh kuang thu a Pathian in, 'Kei Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian ka hi, chi a, amah ahoupihdan na sim kei ua hia?'
english: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

paite: Amah misi Pathian ahi kei a, mihing Pathian ahi zaw; na theikhial tel uh," achi hi.
english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”

paite: Huan laigelhmite lak a mi khat ahong a, akisel uh ana ngaikhia a, Jesu'n amaute thutak in adawng chih athei a, akiang ah, "Thupiak tengteng ah koi ahia thupipen?" chi in adong hi.
heading: Thupiak Thupipen Thu A Dotna / (Mat 22.34-40; Luk 10.25-28)
english: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Athupipen hiai ahi; Israel aw, ngai dih uh, Toupa i Pathian uh Toupa khat kia ahi;
english: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

paite: 'Toupa na Pathian na lungtang tengteng in, na kha tengteng in, na lungsim tengteng in leh na hatna tengteng in na it ding ahi,' chih.
english: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.

paite: Azom hiai ahi, 'Nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding,' chih. Hiaite sang a thupiak thupizaw a-om kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

paite: Laigelhmi'n akiang ah, "Hina ngei e, Sinsakpa amah zaw khat kia ahi a, amah lou zaw kuamah dang a-om kei,
english: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;

paite: amah lungtang tengteng, theihsiamna tengteng, hatna tengteng a it a, eimah i ki-it bang a vengte it halmang thilpiak leh kithoihna tengteng sang in ahoihzaw petmah chih, na gen dik ngei," achi hi.
english: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

paite: Piltak in adawng chih Jesu'n atheih in akiang ah, "Pathian lalgam na gamlat kei hi," achi a, huai nungsiah kuamah in thu adong ngamta kei uhi.
english: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.

paite: Huan tempul a Jesu'n thu ahilh lai in, amau ahoupih a, "Khrist David tapa ahi chih laigelhmite'n bangchidan a gen uh ahia?
heading: Messia Tanchin Dotna / (Mat 22.41-46; Luk 21.5-6)
english: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

paite: David ngei in, Kha Siangthou in, Toupa'n, ka Toupa kiang ah, 'Na melmate na khepek ngakna a ka bawl masiah ka taklam ah tu in, achi,' achi hi.
english: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

paite: "David ngei in amah Toupa, achi ngal a, koi a kipan in ahia amah atapa ahih?" achi hi. Huan mivantang in kipaktak in athu angaikhia uhi.
english: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

paite: Huan athuhilhna ah, "Lai-gelhmite lak ah pilvang un; amau puanaktual silh a vak a-ut ua, dawr munte ah mite chibai abuk ua,
heading: Laigelhmite Vauna / (Mat 23.1-36; Luk 20.45-47)
english: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

paite: sinagog ah tutphah hoihpen leh ankuangluina a mun hoihpen adeihtuam nak uh;
english: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,

paite: meithai inn anegai ua, kilimbawl in sawt pipi athum uh; huaite'n siam louh tanna lianzaw atang ding uh," achi hi.
english: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

paite: Huan sumkholna zawn ah atu a; sumkholna a mipi sumkhiakdan a-en a; mihau tampitak in tampipi akhia uhi.
heading: Meithai Thilpiak / (Luk 21.1-4)
english: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

paite: Meithai zawngtak ahong pai a, dal dangka muza nih akhia a, huai tuh paihsa khat hu ahi.
english: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

paite: Jesu'n anungzuite asam a, akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, sumkholna a khe tengteng lak ah hiai meithai zawngtak in akhe tampen hi.
english: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

paite: Hiaite tengteng in aneihlet uh akhia ua; ama'n zaw adeihthoh laitak, aneihsun, ahinna ding tengteng akhe vek ahi," achi hi.
english: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”
